apps.name: JetGlass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass plane spotter
apps.localizedDescription: JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 in a liquid-glass iOS 26 app. Live map with airline labels and ICAO airport search, photo search and downloads via jetapi.dev.
apps.versionDescription: Photo search queries are now cleaned up automatically (extra spaces, lowercase and newlines all work), and you can pick Planespotters.net as a second photo source with a JetPhotos / Planespotters toggle on the Photos tab.
